overview_description.description: Taqatak is an energy company that creates solar energy equipment to help with device charging as well as outdoor advertising. Solar-powered mobile charging stations and solar-enabled umbrellas with built-in charging units are among the company's products, which provide access to clean, renewable energy for outdoor advertising, allowing clients to find and deploy branded solar-powered products for advertising in public spaces anywhere, at any time.
